text:
Aisha: Heads-up — vendor just pushed back our H100 allocation for us-east-1. We're short ~60 units for the May rollout. Need to coordinate procurement + RMA routing for 18 suspected DOA returns and temporary backfill plan.

Marco: Confirmed. Which POs are affected? Do we have serials for the DOAs or is this from the receiving report?

Aisha: PO 98765 and 98766. Receiving flagged 21 failures, vendor validated 18 as DOA after remote diag. Serial list in S3: s3://redwood-proc/gpu-returns/may/serials.csv

VendorXYZ_Bot: Vendor update: we can expedite 12 replacement H100 units out of allocated stock — ETA 4 business days from pickup. Remaining 6 replacements are on next shipment (est 14 business days). For DOA RMA, we require RO number + proof of failure (boot logs). RMA routing options: depot in NJ (fastest) or EU crossdock (if routing to APAC later).

Jin: Impact on clusters — if we lose 60 units we need to throttle some noncritical batch jobs. Can someone confirm which racks in us-east-1 are affected? We should avoid draining compute in racks that hold live SLO traffic.

Sasha: Racks affected: r-us-e1-01..r-us-e1-04 (per inventory). Suggested mitigation: split replacement ship: 12 expedited to NJ depot + 6 to crossdock CA for staggered handoff. If depot accepts immediate swap we can avoid long-term capacity hits.

Marco: Logistics question — can vendor send an AWB for the depot shipments and include replacement serials in the manifest? Need invoice adjustment for finance.

VendorXYZ_Bot: We will provide AWB and provisional manifest. Sample manifest line: 
```
AWB: 123-45678901
SKU: H100-PCIe-80GB
Serials: H100SN0001,H100SN0002,...
RMA_RO: RO-2026-341
```
Will include HS code 8473.30 and indicate DOA swap.

Priya: On cost — expedited replacements add a $450/unit expedite fee + potential surcharge for crossdock. Please confirm total estimated delta before we approve. Also need statement of work for returns handling costs.

Aisha: Acknowledged. Marco — can you get vendor to confirm AWB + expedite fees in writing? Jin and Sasha will draft the temporary capacity plan to shift noncritical jobs to us-east-2 and pause lower-priority experiments. Priya — estimate was ~ $27k in expedite fees if we take all 60 expedited (not recommended).

Marco: Reached out to vendor procurement lead (cc'd). Asked for: 1) AWB + manifest 2) explicit expedite fee line 3) RMA instructions for depot (address + contact + SLA).

VendorXYZ_Bot: Procurement lead reply: we can commit to 12 expedited units (AWB provided) with manifest and expedite fee $450/unit. Remaining 6 replacements: we will allocate from next batch, but can offer loaner 6 units (refurbished) for 30 days while RMA completes. Loaner terms attached.

Aisha: Loaner offer is helpful. Jin — do we accept refurbished loaners for short-term capacity? Need compatibility/firmware notes.

Jin: We can accept loaners if vendor guarantees matched microcode and not older than 6 months. Will need to run quick firmware validation on arrival. Plan: put loaners in r-us-e1-03 only, label, and monitor GPU error logs for 48h.

Sasha: To reduce customs friction for split shipments, request vendor to mark replacements as "replacement under warranty" and include COO + HS code. I'll prep paperwork.

Marco: Vendor confirmed: replacements marked warranty, COO: TH, HS: 8473.30. They'll email commercial invoice with those fields.

Priya: Approving expedite fees for the 12 units only. We should budget for loaner handling and possible customs duty on crossdock. Approve up to $6k for immediate fees pending receipts.

Aisha: Next steps checklist: 
- Marco: get AWB + manifest + written fees (by EOD)
- Vendor: ship 12 expedited to NJ depot, provide RO numbers on pickup
- Jin/Sasha: receive loaners into test rack, run firmware validation, monitor 48h
- Priya: hold budget approval for >12 expedite units until final numbers

Marco: On it. Vendor sent AWB 123-45678901 and manifest PDF. Attaching link: https://vendor-portal.example.com/manifest/98765 (internal link).

Jin: I'll schedule the firmware smoke test and patch policy. Will post results to this thread.

VendorXYZ_Bot: RMA pickup scheduled 2026-05-02 09:00 EDT. Depot contact: julie@vendorxyz.com. RO numbers will be emailed after pickup scan.

Aisha: Perfect. Keep updates here. :thumbsup:
